set-complication                                             -> result=3, data="A complication provider component name is required."
set-complication --ecn component <provider>                  -> result=3, data="Either component name or watchface id are required."
set-complication ... --ecn watchface <face>                  -> result=3, data="A complication slot is required."
set-complication ... --ei slot 0                             -> result=3, data="A complication type is required."
set-complication ... --ei slot 0 --ei type 3 (fallback face) -> result=2, data="set-complication failed. java.lang.IllegalArgumentException: Fallback watch face does not support complications."
set-complication ... --ecn watchface com.google.wear.offhand/_placeholder_ --ei slot 11 --ei type 3 -> result=3, data="Class name cannot be a placeholder."
set-complication ... --ecn watchface com.google.wear.offhand/x --ei slot 11 --ei type 3 -> result=2, data="set-complication failed. com.google.wear.services.watchfaces.FavoriteOperationException: Watch face package is not installed."
unset-complication --ecn component <provider>                -> result=1, data="Favorite Id=[1]"
unset-complication (no extras)                               -> result=3, data="A complication provider component name is required."
unset-watchface                                              -> result=1, data="Favorite Id=[1] Runtime=[2]"
unset-watchface (second call)                                -> result=2, data="unset-watchface failed. java.lang.IllegalStateException: Switched watch face is not set."
